variants.headline: Still in view: a company goes under
variants.sub: The colony has seen the failure of {company}.
variants.body:
The company {company} has gone under. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Workers are not an incidental detail in the politics of business failure. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
